description: The runs that ended of every report the user can see, of any type, newest first, each with its report, for questions such as what failed overnight: pass status failed and since. Same fields as listReportRuns. Answers up to limit runs, 20 by default and 200 at most, and a nextCursor: pass it as cursor for the next page, until it is null.

cursor.description: Where to continue the list: pass the `nextCursor` returned with the previous page to get the next one. Omit it for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of runs to return on this page, from 1 to 200. Defaults to `20`.

since.description: Only what happened at or after this time, as an ISO 8601 date and time in UTC, such as `2026-11-08T18:00:00Z`. If omitted, from the start.

status.description: Only the runs that ended this way, such as `failed`, as `status` in the runs. If omitted, every run.

name: listRuns
title: List runs of all reports
